snippet.title: Cubin II - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮Play Cubin II (Steam, Epic Games, Itch, Humble Bundle): https://limsodgames.com/cubin-ii

Cubin II is a first-person puzzle-platformer game that is the sequel to Cubin.
You are immersed once again in the LGA experience, but this time on the other side of things, at the moment when everything changed after your victory. You quickly discover a new way to escape from this hell. During the 50 new experiments to solve, you will once again be accompanied by Alice, and you will have to team up to move forward together.

In this alternate world, each experiment becomes more difficult, and the mechanics are more advanced.
Discover new ways to propel yourself, move through the darkness, wield the cube, and even think and explore. Think carefully and surpass yourself during these final trials, but be careful, because no missteps will be tolerated...
